test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select one of the reasons mentioned in the passage for buying an EV.

options.text: 40 to 45% higher price than normal vehicles

solution:
Here the correct answer is **To protect our mother earth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is **1) To protect our mother earth.**
 
• The passage mentions that "saving on petrol and diesel and contributing to saving our mother earth are rational reasons to buy it" when discussing the reasons for the increasing enthusiasm for owning Electric Vehicles.
 
• Therefore, protecting the environment is one of the reasons mentioned in the passage for buying an EV.
 
• **Option 2) Higher mileage than normal vehicles **and **Option 3) 40 to 45% higher price than normal vehicles** are mentioned in the passage, but not as reasons for buying an EV.
 
• **Option 4) Government policy** is not mentioned as a reason for buying an EV.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
